capabilities: Insert block links by typing ^^ inside a wikilink
Search blocks within a note by remembered phrase
Write readable ^slugs onto target lines when missing
Realign slugs and inbound links when opening words change
Insert block links via command palette commands
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists planned features not yet implemented, such as vault-wide block search. Links survive disabling the plugin because they use core #^ syntax.
intentEvidence: Native random hex block ids still work. We just refuse to make more of them on purpose.
problem: Obsidian assigns random hex block ids like #^fa5d4c, making block links hard to read, remember, or write by hand.
summary: Block-link helper that inserts readable Obsidian block references: type ^^ inside a wikilink, search blocks by phrase, and get a ^slug id.
